_comment: Captured at b6802e4f (2026-10-14) BEFORE any cycle-129 Sprint 2 reader or config change, by evaluating each reader's own yq expression against three configs: the shipped example (.loa.config.yaml.example, what a fresh install copies), this repository's .loa.config.yaml, and an empty config (the reader's own fallback). `standard` is the value profiles.yaml must carry for the key: the post-cycle example default (DEC-0128, DEC-0143). For every key except the two guardrail keys it equals example_today. The two guardrail keys change default in this cycle (D-4.4, DEC-0161): example_today records the old default and standard the new one, side by side. tests/unit/profile-lib.bats compares profiles.yaml against this file. Note: the readers that used `// true` (guardrails.input.enabled, guardrails.danger_level.enforce, karpathy_principles.require_success_criteria) read an explicit `false` as true, because yq's alternative operator treats false like null; the values below are what those expressions returned, and none of the three configs set an explicit false for those keys at capture time.

karpathy_principles.surgical_diff_warnin.expr: yq -r '.karpathy_principles.surgical_diff_warning | tostring | (. == "false" or ... "OFF")' (the hook runs unless an explicit false-equivalent is set)

guardrails.input.enabled._comment: Default changes this cycle (D-4.4, DEC-0161): the example now ships false (82 events, zero catches, seven blocks on sanctioned skills). This repository sets true explicitly so the orchestrator keeps logging. A migration item, not a profile effect.

guardrails.danger_level.enforce._comment: Default changes this cycle (D-4.4, DEC-0161): the example and this repository now set false. A migration item, not a profile effect.

invisible_retrospective.enabled.expr: yq '.invisible_retrospective.enabled == true' (the prose runs the scan only on an explicit true)
